task.goal: Fix slugify so accented Latin letters are converted to their plain equivalents instead of being dropped: slugify('Crème Brûlée') should return 'creme-brulee', not 'cr-me-br-l-e'.

acceptance.behavior: Accented Latin letters are converted to the unaccented letter before slugging: slugify('Crème Brûlée') returns 'creme-brulee' and slugify('Señor Ñandú') returns 'senor-nandu'.

acceptance.behavior: Text without accented letters produces exactly the same slug as before the change. The existing tests in test/slugify.test.js pass without being modified or removed.
